name: Central China Land Media CO.,LTD
summary: Central China Land Media CO.,LTD, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the editing, production, and marketing of publications in China. The company publishes textbooks and supplementary teaching materials; rental publication of textbooks; and printing and production of rented and self-owned textbooks, supplementary teaching materials, and general books, as well as books, periodicals, newspapers, and other publications from other companies.
